name: Trusted Stats
description: A three-part trust band: left heading with primary + ghost buttons, a middle trusted-by placeholder logo grid over three headline stats, and a right real photo visual with a floating caption card.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the three columns fade up staggered (wpmn-ts-up 600ms, 90/180ms)
buttons shift background on hover; the photo carries a warm warning-tint overlay with a floating caption card
prefers-reduced-motion: content rendered in place, no animation
